summary: Corpse Locator works again in Mineshafts: an ordinary armor

sections.title: More
items: Corpse Locator works again in Mineshafts: an ordinary armor stand nearby no longer switched it (and the Mineshaft HUD and detection) off for the session. New cheat-build Corpse Scan finds every loaded Frozen Corpse at any distance, and "You've already looted this corpse!" now marks that corpse looted.
Mining no longer freezes the game for a moment on island changes (Dark Stone redrew the whole block texture atlas twice), a rare drop message no longer stalls the game while Luck rebuilt every row
Lever Aura flicks again while the server keeps teleporting you (a teleport every tick no longer holds every flick back).
Corpse Locator now boxes a Frozen Corpse only once it has been in your line of sight; after that it stays marked through walls. The cheat build's Corpse Scan still finds every loaded corpse.
Auto Correct now fixes a mistyped /warp destination against every Fast Travel destination, and completes a cut-off one like /warp bas to /warp base when exactly one destination fits.

Auto Routes: a secret bat that was already standing there when a node began waiting (or that spawned far off and was then walked up to) now counts toward the node's secret await, so the route no longer stalls on it

Auto Trap: New Trap and Old Trap have bundled Just Cleared routes and the mode defaults to Just Cleared (Full Trap only with your own capture), and a start-node warp into a trap room now lands on the route's start block instead of firing from the trap's doorway and being refused ("You cannot use abilities in this room!").
Multi Warp Mode: Tick Split now says in chat, once, when it cannot split because Blink Charge is off or has no covered bank, and its tooltip says it needs Blink Charge on.

Auto Clear is faster: doors open from the blocks, not the map, and a door that ran out of clicks before its key came is clicked again once the key arrives; an Auto Clear queued in the green room starts at the run start; rooms next door hand off at once and a handed-over room is done at its last kill; a path warp the server never answers is sent again one landing time later; Auto Clear and Auto Secret started after a mid-run rejoin start at once DROPPED superseded by acgaps2-1121-b

Auto Clear is faster: doors open from the blocks, not the map, and a door that ran out of clicks before its key came is clicked again once the key arrives; an Auto Clear queued in the green room starts at the run start; rooms next door hand off at once and a handed-over room is done at its last kill; a path warp the server never answers is sent again one landing time later; Auto Clear and Auto Secret started after a mid-run rejoin start at once

Bug reports now hold what is needed to diagnose a missing HUD or scoreboard line (sidebar, tab info, island, what each stat reader parsed, HUD element states, language, GUI scale, resource packs), and /bugreport <what is wrong> saves your note in the report.

Autopilot no longer stands still for about half a second after the last warp of each trip to a door, room or secret spot: it moves on the tick the server confirms the landing, and left-clicks a door on that tick.

Dungeons Autopilot: Dungeon Autopilot, Auto Secret, Auto Clear and Auto Blood Rush are now one cheat card with one switch and one keybind. Pick a Mode (Solo 300, Clear Then Secret, Secret Then Clear, Party Secrets), a Blood Rush (None, Clear, Door), Disable After Blood Rush, Clear First, Clear Room Before Secreting, Room Before Blood and the rest in one place; your old start key carries over.
Team Melody's settings no longer load during a frame, which could stall the game for a moment.

Dungeon Autopilot on the Solo 300 goal plans each room once (clear it or do the secrets the score still needs, least travel first); Clear First and the Clear Then Secret mode clear every room's mobs before any secret, opening a wither door to reach more; Party Secrets opens a door to more secrets before clearing; Clear Room Before Secreting and Room Before Blood: Skip are followed. Auto Secret and the Autopilot come back to the Quiz just as the next question opens: the countdown is filled with a route or a room's mob clear and decided again while it waits, a clear started in it is cut when only the trip back is left, and a trip it could not find a way for once is looked for again; with nothing else left on this side it clears a route room cut short or, with a Wither Key in hand, opens the wither door meanwhile
New Trap's bundled Just Cleared Auto Trap route no longer stalls at its breaker node: a trap-room walk lines up on the node's point before it fires, and gives your view back on any tick you attack.
Blood Camp Stats: time lost reads unknown (or at least N) when the camp is out of entity range instead of 0 (26.3 cheat 5 pass, 26.3 legit 4 pass, 26.2 cheat 4 pass)

Auto Trap starts faster: a route no longer stops while your ender pearl is still in the air or a walk is lining up, the bundled trap walk is used from the first entry instead of being replaced by a fresh plan, and a warp held by a block that does not break is planned again from where you stand after half a second (forced after a second and a half) instead of waiting for a left click

Auto Clear: a charged map path now presses the sneak first and fires its warps only once the server has had it (its first warp turned into an Instant Transmission and every landing after it slid one hop), a precomputed trip that went wrong from a spot is never handed out again from that spot, after the server moves you mid-path the new path starts at once instead of waiting behind Autopilot's room order or the floor map warming up in the background, a warp that never landed is not planned again from the same spot until something near it changes, a room with a far end (Long Hall) is no longer left at the last death you can see while its far end is out of sight, the direct one-warp trip no longer repeats a warp that never landed from that spot, and Dungeon Autopilot's off message now names the real reason it stopped.

Dungeons Autopilot switched on in the Entrance before the run now walks you to the front of the Entrance door while it waits, so the first trip goes straight through the door instead of spending two etherwarps reaching it; any movement key of yours takes over

Dungeons Autopilot no longer starts the moment you enter a new dungeon while the last run is still held for a rejoin: it arms and waits for the run to start; Auto Clear Door Only no longer stands still at the Entrance when its first wither door is too far away to be loaded

Dungeons Autopilot and Auto Clear no longer lose a Wither Key on the way to Blood: a wither door is opened only once the map shows the room behind it (at most 2 s), because a door opened into a room the map does not show yet clears that room at once and its key never drops

Auto Melody's Harp no longer misses or mis-clicks notes at 150-320 ms ping: an early click is timed from when each step of the board arrives and goes on the first frame it falls due, instead of on game ticks
Lever Aura: a frame that stalls between its body turn and the hand-back no longer swings the camera 180 degrees with the body.

Dungeons Autopilot leaves a wither or blood door sooner: it no longer clicks a door that is already opening, readies the next etherwarp while the door's barriers stand, and plans its next trip the tick they go
Milestone Display now shows 0 from the start of a dungeon run, and counts the class-prefixed milestone lines (Archer, Healer, Berserk)

Dungeons Autopilot no longer leaves a Wither Key behind when it drops in the moment a room is cleared: it waits a moment for the key and picks it up before going to the blood door, and it decides again when a Blood Key appears while it waits at the blood door

/bugreport now opens a Bug Report screen: type a title and a description, then Save the zip or Save and Post it to the Discord's bug report forum with your description and the list of files; the zip now also holds the mod's recent log lines and the automation state.

Zero Ping Etherwarp: a warp sent the tick right after you start sneaking, which Hypixel can cast from your standing eye height and land a block or two further, now counts as the warp's own landing instead of a miss, and when the server puts you anywhere but the exact predicted block, the warps still waiting behind it are predicted again from where you really are instead of dropped.

summary: Fast Leap now works in the dungeon sim even with no Sim Team

sections.title: More
items: Fast Leap now works in the dungeon sim even with no Sim Teammate placed (the tab lists the four classes the leap menu offers), and a completed P3 section's Fast Leap goes to the target of the section you are standing in instead of the section that just finished.
Auto Melody's Harp (cheat build only) plays any Melody's Harp song you open, with Auto Detect Lag, Auto Detect Ping and a Click Offset slider.

Dungeon sim: each wardrobe slot is now its own set, as on Hypixel, so a mask you swap in by hand stays with the set you leave and comes back with it, while the helmet it replaced stays in your inventory
Closing the game while Spotify's media helper is stuck no longer hangs the shutdown and draws a watchdog crash.
Insta Clear tracker: saving its evidence file after a room closes no longer happens on the game tick, so it cannot cause a stutter.

Menu audit fixes: wrong and missing tooltips, labels and spellings corrected, Storage Overlay and Ghost ESP through walls now start OFF, Terminal First Click Delay 150 ms, Auto Terminals click delay 120-160 ms, launcher-neutral Account Switcher wording.
Auto Correct now fixes a short command typed with one extra letter, such as /ety to /et.
Block Ender Pearls In Boss no longer blocks Spirit Leaps, only plain Ender Pearls.
Dungeon map: a large room no longer splits into two rooms with the same name partway through a run.

Auto Terminals no longer waits on or stalls at a click another mod's terminal solver blocked: Rubix and Click in Order finish in about 2 s again instead of 4 s or more, and the dungeon sim's terminals answer a click with only the changed slots, as Hypixel does.

Dungeon sim: the Watcher now behaves like the real one in the blood camp. He flies to each skull he picks and hovers over it, greets with the real line, sends the first wave and the later skulls at the real times, says a summon line on the tick a skull leaves, comments on a kill a moment after it and says the pass line shortly after the last kill.

New Melody's Harp Helper tab: press keys 1 to 7 to play the harp columns (rebindable, with labels in the click row), a progress tracker with hits, combo and best, a custom GUI scale just for the harp, hidden item tooltips, and a quick restart when you replay a song. Auto Melody's Harp no longer misses notes after a server lag or a burst: it clicks a new note the moment it shows.
Door Keys: the Sphere highlight is now one even color from every angle instead of a patchwork that shifted as you moved.
Dungeon sim: a left click or right click on a wither or blood door opens it with any item in hand once you have the key, including the Dungeonbreaker, which still cannot break door blocks.

New cheat feature Map Cycler (default off, /roomcycle or a keybind): re-rolls the dungeon until the rooms you must open to reach Blood are at most the number you set. It keeps a map only when what the map shows proves Blood is that close ("Kept: Blood is at most N room(s) away."), using wither doors and room shapes; any other map is re-rolled a fixed 1 s after the creation cooldown ends, and it works only in the Entrance room before the run starts

Dungeon sim: with Real Mob Looks on, a miniboss room's miniboss now stands where one was seen on Hypixel in that room (turned with the room) instead of a random spot; Blood Rush Helper now remembers where a miniboss first stood, so rooms you visit fill in over time.
Auto Teleport Maze now sprints on every walk, about 30% faster from pad to pad, to the start pad and out to the exit. Auto Ice Fill no longer loses about 3 ticks on a hop whose landing arrives late.

Map Cycler: new Keep Chance (F7) setting keeps an F7 map that is not proven close enough when it is at least that likely to have Blood within Max Rooms Before Blood, counted from 454 real F7 floors (default 90%, 100% keeps only proven maps), and the proof now knows puzzles and the trap are never on the way to Blood, the way always passes the Fairy and the Entrance has one door.
Auto Simon Says no longer loses or misorders steps when the game freezes for a moment during a reveal, so it no longer waits forever on a missed step or presses a wrong button.
A short server stall no longer makes Auto Terminals and timers fall back to client ticks, which could put a terminal click over Hypixel's click limit.

summary: Inventory Sorter now waits 0.25 s between sack fetches inste

sections.title: More
items: Inventory Sorter now waits 0.25 s between sack fetches instead of 3 s; a fetch Hypixel refuses for cooldown is asked again after 1 s, up to 5 times.
Hide Players no longer hides Shadow Assassins, minibosses or NPCs (only real players), and has a new Only In Chosen Phases switch with a row for each Floor 7 / Master 7 boss phase.
Blood Camp's Mage Only, the leap menu and class-only features now follow a class swap: the class the game shows wins over an old Leap Order pick on your own name.

Lever Aura: the click on the heard look when no packet can carry a look is now behind a new switch, No-Look Lever Click (flags Grim), default OFF; with it off both levers no longer draw anticheat flags.

New Item Alerts card (Items): Bottle Full Alert for Thunder, Storm and Hurricane in a Bottle and Runebook Rarity Alert, as movable HUDs with sound and Persistent or Timed display (26.3 cheat green; legit and 26.2 compile only)

Auto Routes: new Breaker Style setting picks the break style routes use (Breaker Aura card, Legit Multi Break or Burst Multi Break) without changing the Breaker Aura card; a breaker block is dug again only after the server has answered its first dig, and Burst digs only blocks the current look strikes.

Auto Creeper Beams melee: the cut-short teleport landing is taken when it is in reach, the click is sent again only after a fall, the Blocks in the way line is hidden, and no hit goes out in the tick of your own use, now in the legit build too.
The game no longer freezes when a settings file save is slow: the Custom Scoreboard, mining, armor HUD and fairy soul saves moved off the game thread.

Share To Website now records your terminal solve times in the F7 and M7 boss and times your Fastest F7, M7, F7 Solo Clear, M7 Solo Clear and P3 in real runs, uploading each new personal best to the website's leaderboards on its own; nothing is sent until you have seen its notice.

Carnival is not part of the mod until after 2.0: its tracker, Fruit Digging, Zombie Shootout and Catch a Fish helpers, their cheat autos and the Carnival Games row of Auto Dialogue are removed for now; saved Carnival settings are kept.
Slot Text now also shows the level number on level I perks in the Essence Shops.
Test-only fix: two menu test cases that never ran in the ship lanes are now listed so they run.

Time Lost To Melody: new Send To Party Chat switch posts the run's total and each section's share to party chat after Goldor's last section; a Melody you finished earlier is no longer blamed on a later terminal. Core Entry Times: new Only Slowest switch shows just the slowest player.

Auto Terminals: Burst Size and Max Clicks Per Burst now top out at 5 and Burst Mode sends at most 5 terminal clicks in 550 ms, the most Hypixel takes in 10 ticks; the bug report now states the exact build (commit, variant, release or dev, testing, jar).
No Rotate was removed because Hypixel no longer turns you on a leap.
The mod no longer flashes a command prompt window when Spotify, Copy Screenshot, an ffmpeg import or a browser lookup starts a helper program.
Dungeon sim: /wardrobe, /stats, /loadouts and the new /class now match Hypixel (Terror and Thermodynamic sets, loadout spots chosen in Sim Settings, class menu).
Auto Tic Tac Toe: the Walk Out When Done setting is removed; after the solve nothing moves you, so you can etherwarp out yourself.

Auto Clear with a Hyperion: one Wither Impact now aims across to reach more mobs, a cast chains on to the next mob instead of an etherwarp trip when that is quicker, the Hyperion is already in hand and aimed when a trip lands, and a clear no longer skips a starred mob because the clear before went to the same spot

Sim co-op now goes through the private relay by default: no player sees anyone's IP address, and a new Share My IP setting (off by default) lets a friend connect directly when the relay is full or down.
Test fix only: the join fingerprint smoke case no longer fails on a starved test server (opensign resent, more join tries).
Breaker Aura Auto Swap no longer gets stuck after you change your own hotbar slot, and its obsidian dig now waits for the look the server heard before stopping or restarting.

Sound Disabler: new Custom Sounds screen lists every sound in the game with a search, a 0 to 200 percent volume slider, Mute and Preview per sound, plus a Volume Sliders option that puts the same slider under each preset sound. Above 100 percent a sound plays as two copies (about twice as loud at most).

Magic Find reads Hypixel's current drop line so Luck counts kills at your real Magic Find, Run History and Share To Website time a run from the same start as Split Timers, Auto Requeue stops sending /instancerequeue once the server says only the instance creator can, and the Maxor crystal respawn timer is 6 ticks longer while the Storm Purple audit row is gone.

summary: Low Health Alert: new Alert For Yourself switch (on by defau

sections.title: More
items: Low Health Alert: new Alert For Yourself switch (on by default) also warns when your own health drops under 30% (50% for getting low), once until it recovers.
Slot Text: perks in the Essence Shops (such as Forbidden Blessing X) now show their level as the small slot number, unless the stack count already shows it.

How Lucky Are You now counts kills made with Implosion, Spirit Sceptre, Guided Sheep and other ability hits and with bow shots, no longer loses drop lines that arrive before the kill or two at once, and matches armor piece drops and three more 5% drops to their odds.
Terminals and menus no longer close by themselves a few seconds after a Fast Leap: a held menu close for a window the server had already shut is now dropped instead of sent late.

The Dungeon ESP card is now Dungeon Mob Highlight (search still finds it by esp); mob color rows show only while that mob is on, Wither Boss Highlight has per-boss switches, and the cheat ESP switch is split into Mob ESP and Wither ESP.
Item Protect: in a dungeon the drop key still works as your class ability and ultimate even while you hold a protected item or Block Every Drop is on; menu drops stay blocked.

Dungeon map: a room no longer reads all secrets found (and stays white) when Hypixel credited fewer; the map's secret count now follows the action bar even with Hide Actionbar on, and lever clicks are no longer counted as secrets.

Interactive Map: you can now click the predicted part of a room (a tile the map draws from Predictive Rooms but has not scanned yet) and the strip joining it, and it goes to that room like a click on a scanned tile.

Dungeon Autopilot Blood First: after a key room it now goes straight to the door (a just-picked-up key counts at once, and it waits a moment for the room's key to drop instead of starting another room), and no puzzle (Quiz, Ice Fill and the rest) is started until the blood door is open; a puzzle room on the way is only walked through
Profile Viewer, Mining page: the Heart of the Mountain perks are drawn as the real tree, each perk at its slot with its icon and level, and hovering shows the effect at your level.

Auto Terminals no longer loses clicks to Hypixel's terminal click limit (5 clicks in 10 ticks): a Min Delay under 100 ms or Burst Finish right after paced clicks used to send clicks the server dropped, each costing a retry.
Fast/Auto Leap: the Set Class Targets page no longer shows the Universal-uses-the-Universal-target status line.
Puzzle HUD no longer lists puzzles from your previous dungeon run next to the current run's puzzles.
Auto Routes: the Legit/Obvious Mode setting is gone from every build for now; Auto Routes always runs in obvious mode.

Party tracking no longer goes stale: joining a Party Finder group, restarting the game while in a party, a promotion, a transfer or a leave now update who is in your party and who leads it at once, without running /party list; Party Commands, the Custom Scoreboard crown and Spotify lyrics all read the same party state.

Iced Mob Boxes now outlines a mob only while it shows the Ice Spray freeze (the ice block on its head) and drops the box the moment the ice goes; it works for any player's freeze and no longer guesses from your wand clicks.

Profile Viewer Networth page: Priced at is now a button (Est. Item Value, Instant Sell, Average BIN, NPC Sell), Showing adds a Non-Soulbound total (leaves out soulbound items and the Museum), and the Bazaar Prices and Lowest BIN Prices rows are gone.
Secret waypoints now show in Gold: its room corner is found even though a gold block above the roof row made the roof look one block higher, so the wither essence gets its waypoint.
HUD editor: opened over a menu (RNG Meter, Superpairs, Start ETable, Start Croesus) it no longer draws the live panel under its own, so the RNG Meter ranking is readable and shows the real rows.
Secret Clicked: every click on a locked chest plays the locked sound, and a locked chest you click again never plays the secret sound unless it really opens.
Auto Accept Invites: Only From Guild Members reads your guild list once each session

Dungeon sim: Sim Teammates are now named after their class (Healer, Tank, Archer, Berserk, Mage) instead of Teammate1-4, so leap menus, leap lines and the tab show the class, and each leap tile is drawn in its class color. session entry: 500-boss-session:,1116-sim-infileap,1116-sim-classes,1117-sim-leapspots

Auto Superboom now also swaps to your Superboom when the block you click is not a target but a Superboom placed there would blow one up (within 3 blocks of the face you hit); new Also When In Blast Range switch, on by default.

Dungeon Sim Help (/help) now looks like the other sim menus: the page list in the raised left column, Close at the bottom left, Back and Next at the bottom right with the page number centered, and pictures of the screens and places each page talks about.
Slot Text: Forbidden Intel in the Essence Shops no longer shows its level twice.
Party Commands: Officer chat is now a channel like Guild (off by default); it answers the same ! commands and replies with /oc.
Auto Anvil: new Start Mode setting. Start Button (default) shows a Start Auto Anvil / Stop Auto Anvil button in the anvil menu; Auto Start begins by itself when the menu opens, as before.
Inventory search bar: a blinking _ caret shows while you type in it; the empty focused bar shows just the caret instead of the hint.

Terminal Timers: new Time Lost To Melody (Split Timers rows, its own HUD, a chat line per phase and an overall one, all default off): the time a Goldor section waited when its last terminal was a Melody, counted only when Melody is last, never carried over, 0 when unknown.
Auto Terminals: new No First Click Delay In Melody switch (cheat build, off by default) clicks the first Melody row without waiting First Click Delay; other terminals keep the delay.
Wither pick Goldor triggerbot work from the witherpick branch.
Auto Secret: while the Quiz countdown runs and no secret room fits it now clears an uncleared mob room meanwhile instead of going back and standing at the Quiz
Mods Screen has an ON/OFF switch (default ON); while OFF the mod adds no Mods button to the main menu or pause menu
Sound Effects: six new sounds (Water Drop, Coin Clink, Marimba, Deep Thud, Zap, Sparkle) and a Volume slider on every row, 0-200%

Ability Cooldowns and Metal Detector now read the action bar line they depend on (before, nothing reached them, and Hide Actionbar blocked them too); the dungeon Self Derivation reads it the same way.
Leap Order: the class you click for yourself now stays yours until you leave the party; leaving or a kick resets it and the layout
Command Auto Correct now fixes a warp destination typed with a stray space, such as /warp d h.

Dungeon sim: terminals now send each slot as its own update, so Auto Terminals clicks are no longer blocked when another mod's terminal solver is also on (Click in Order never getting a click); every sim terminal type is tested against such solvers.
Profile Viewer: new /pv Command switch (default ON); while OFF the mod leaves /pv alone so the server's or another mod's /pv runs.
Chat translation now handles messages typed in Latin letters for languages like Bulgarian and Russian, and never shows the original text as a translation.

Auto Accept Invites' Only From Guild Members now reads your guild from the mod's relay (Hypixel API) instead of sending /guild list; the chat command is only the fallback when the relay cannot be reached.
RNG Meter: the best pick's slot now pulses with a bright fill and border so it is easy to spot; hovering an item in the RNG Meter menu now also shows its value.

Reparty: typing !reinv in party chat now makes you leave (if you are not the leader) and rejoin, a leader kicks and re-invites whoever types it after a Reinv Delay you set (1-15 s), and Rejoin After Kick accepts your party's invite back after a kick, not only after a disband.
Dungeon Sim Help now lists each page as short bullet points instead of sentences, and its pictures are twice as sharp.
Profile Viewer: Spider, Wolf, Enderman and Blaze slayer levels now use the right XP thresholds.

Profile Viewer fits every style at GUI scales 2/3/4: centered sidebar heads, readable Basic info, Show Status button, bigger inventory grids with a search bar, own Quiver/Potion Bag/Fishing Bag buttons, Sacks under Inventories, uncapped pet level, collection totals, divided text pages.

Auto Routes: a warp now waits 3 ticks instead of 2 after a chest or lever click made with the same Aspect of the Void (Hypixel refused about one in five at 2), and two etherwarp nodes in a row after a Secret Aura click no longer wait a tick between them

summary: Pickaxe ability HUD: "Active" is now green and the time left

sections.title: More
items: Pickaxe ability HUD: "Active" is now green and the time left fades from green to yellow to red as the ability runs out.
Dungeon sim: the Spirit Sceptre bat now steers toward where you are looking while it flies instead of flying one straight line.
Inventory Sorter: saved layouts now show every item's real icon, also for items you are not holding.

Dungeon Sim: typing /help inside the sim now opens Dungeon Sim Help, a themed walk-through of the sim (floors, settings, commands you can click, items, boss, co-op, keys and what is not simulated yet); the first time the sim opens it says one chat line about it.
Accessory Advisor reads the new Hypixel Accessory Bag again and lists each missing accessory once per family, as its lowest tier.
Dungeon map: a room's name is now centered on the room's shape (Museum's sat to one side).

Lever Aura: a lever clicked while you walk now gets a pitch-only look through the lever's whole block (or your first still tick) instead of a held click the anticheat canceled, so the second lever of a route is flicked too; a flick the lever does not answer is sent again.

Collection Tracker: a sack that compacts items (for example 15,040 Enchanted Gold Ingot into 94 Enchanted Gold Blocks) now counts only the net gain, so Gold no longer reads about 3 times too high and the HUD rate matches the server.
Bazaar lookups now also find a product under its announced new or old name (Epic Bait, Legendary Bait, Enchanted Clay), ready for Hypixel's coming Wolf Slayer tier 5 and fishing update.
The Fiesta Flask timer no longer pauses or says paused and counts down every second, and the Maniac Miner mana drain now lasts up to 50 seconds.
Dungeon Map: new Stream Safe switch under Funny Map (cheat build, Windows) - anything that records or shares your game sees the normal map with no mimic room, while you still see the Funny Map
Personal Mining Compactor and the other skill compactor menus: entries that are on are highlighted green and entries that are off red.

Hide Ghost Mobs now hides only starred mobs left in rooms the dungeon map shows cleared, so real mobs that are just standing still are no longer hidden; unstarred mobs, Blood room mobs and the boss are never hidden

Missing Enchants (Items): hold Shift over a SkyBlock item to see the normal enchants it can still take, never ultimates or enchants that conflict with ones it has; an option also lists enchants below their max level.
Object Hider: new Arrow Particles switch hides the particle trail of arrows.

Dungeon sim: in the F7/M7 boss a Spirit Leap now goes to where that class stands in the current phase, with its look (Maxor pads, Storm, each Goldor section, Necron's Healer only, under the spawning dragon in P5); alone the leap menu lists the four classes you do not play; a leap to a class with no spot there says you leaped wrong and moves nothing; new Co-op Leaps setting (Default Leaps / Player Leaps); the P5 dragons now spawn in a random order Dungeon sim F7 boss: at Necron a Spirit Leap to any class lands on Necron's platform; Maxor's Energy Crystals are placed by standing next to a pylon's pressure plate, never by a click, so leaping from a pad works (builds on simleapspots-1117, which it contains)

Item Protect: a protected hotbar item can no longer be dropped by any path (drop key, Ctrl+Q, Q over its slot, dropping it outside the window), Block Every Drop now covers all of them for any hotbar item, and the repeat-press Confirm To Force setting is removed.

Pack Disabler: the approved looks for 78 newer items. Talismans, rings, artifacts, powders, boosters, sprayonators, nozzles, honey pots, Critter Capsules (by state) and Safari Belts (by rarity) show as player heads with skins bundled in the mod; Bee Saliva, Rainbow Feather and others show as vanilla items; Carnival Shovels are plain iron, golden and diamond shovels. Enchanted items keep their glint, a head skin sent by the server always wins, and nothing is downloaded. 30 drawn textures got pixel fixes.

Auto Accept Invites has three new switches, Only From Friends, Only From Guild Members and Only From Best Friends (all off by default): with any on, only a party invite from someone in an on group is accepted.

Timing sliders now use the unit that fits: click rates are a delay in ms instead of CPS (Arrow Align, Lights Device, Powder Chest, Wither Boss Triggerbot, Auto i4, Shortbow Auto Clicker), delays that act on whole game ticks step by 50 ms, Interactive Map Path Timeout is in seconds, and every unit reads with a space. Old CPS settings convert on load.

One jar for Prism and the Modrinth App: Account Swapper, its ban status and the Proxy Client work the same under both launchers; a Modrinth-only PC keeps the shared ban status and Universal proxy files beside the app's own data.
Run Stats: your own secrets are now exact from the end-of-run Stats block, and teammates' secrets show only once they add up to the team total (a ? instead of a stale or wrong number).

RNG Meter Overlay: new Highlight Best option (on by default while the overlay is on) marks the slot of the best reward on the open RNG Meter page, the most coins per meter point, the same number the ranking shows; rewards with no price are never picked.

Auto Reclaim (Items): highlights every item the new /reclaim command would give something back for, /autoreclaim lists them in chat, and the cheat build can pull them out of storage and reclaim them; the Reclaim Menu now has Reclaim Inventory (what you carry) and Reclaim All (every storage page) buttons
Interactive Map: the Open From HUD Click option is gone, and a path started from the map no longer draws green waypoint boxes and lines in the world.
Chat Channel Indicator: new Show setting, While Chat Is Open (as before) or Always, where it is its own movable Chat Channel HUD element.
Command Prefixes: typing your Alternate Prefix character in game (for example .) now opens the chat with it already typed, like / does; new Prefix Key Opens Chat switch, on by default.
Watcher Helper now grades the Watcher's speaking time from his real runs: Vroom under 14.5 s, Watcher under 15.5 s, Yawn under 16.5 s, Zzz after (the old cutoffs graded every Watcher Vroom).

summary: Inventory Sorter: Fetch Missing From Sacks now waits 3 secon

sections.title: More
items: Inventory Sorter: Fetch Missing From Sacks now waits 3 seconds between /gfs commands and sends a refused one again instead of calling the item empty; items spread over several storage stacks are combined first, the extra goes back to storage, and only the exact rest comes from sacks.
Main menu: with the custom title screen off, the vanilla title screen now has Dungeon Sim, Mod Settings, What's New, Mods and Swap Accounts as plain vanilla buttons
Dungeon sim: etherwarping in the boss room no longer disconnects you.
none (test fix: the luck cases turn on the default-off RNG Meter and Experiments tracker; mod unchanged, lesson only)
Deployable range spheres and circles (Mining) now stay put: each deployable keeps the spot it was first seen at instead of following its bobbing label, so the sphere no longer shifts and flickers.

New Chat Channel Indicator (off by default, Chat category): a line just above the chat input, "Chat: Party (5 members)", names the Hypixel chat channel your next message goes to (All, Party, Guild, Officer, Skyblock Co-op or a private conversation), with Show Member Count and Use Hypixel Colors settings.

Mining HUDs: the Fiesta Flask timer now counts down every second between tab reads and ends when the tab drops it or reads zero, and a mining ability you are using shows Active until it ends, then its cooldown.
Auto Terminals (cheat) has a new Mode setting: Normal keeps paced clicks with Burst Finish, Burst sends every click in bursts of up to Max Clicks Per Burst with a Delay Between Bursts.

Dungeon sim: InfiniLeap and Spirit Leap open the leap menu and teleport to a teammate, a new Sim Teammates setting places up to four standing teammates, Sim Class and Class Level settings pick Healer, Mage, Berserk, Archer or Tank with their Drop Stack and Drop abilities, and Bonzo's Mask and Spirit Mask save you from a lethal hit with 3 seconds of invulnerability while a fishing rod swaps your pet between Phoenix and Golden Dragon
Auto Terminals Burst mode now keeps bursts at least 75 ms apart even at a delay of 0, so a late server tick no longer takes two bursts at once.

Auras no longer change your movement while you walk or run an AP3 route: Lever Aura, Terminal Aura, Secret Aura and Arrow Align click without touching your keys, sprint or turn, and AP3 keeps walking under a terminal Terminal Aura opens.
Dungeon sim: /start s4 (and p1 p2 s1 s2 s3 core p4 p5 stop) now starts the F7 boss at that phase, with tab completion; it used to say Unknown or incomplete command (it only worked as /simboss)
Lever Aura and other block-clicking automation no longer draw an anticheat flag when a teleport arrives right as they click

Blood Rush Helper and the Dungeon Sim now use one shared set of spawn boxes for every room it covers (our own boxes only for the one room it lacks); spawn learning, its switches and the learned-spots file are gone. NOTE for achype-1117: BloodRushSpots is deleted; read spots from BloodRushData.worldBoxes(room, frame) (AABB per box; old knownSpots point = ((minX+maxX)/2, minY, (minZ+maxZ)/2)) or BloodRushData.boxes(room) (room-relative).

Magic Find now raises every mob and slayer drop in How Lucky Are You (cap 500), Looting no longer changes its odds, Special accessories give no Magical Power in the Accessory Advisor, and the Rift Prism counts as a normal accessory.
Powder mining Treasure Chest highlight now works only in the Crystal Hollows.
RNG Meter's Superpairs list now matches the in-game Experimentation Table: ten enchantment books added, and Drain and Woodsplitter books are priced under their Bazaar names.

Profile Viewer: the Rift Accessory Bag is now a view of the Rift page, accessory Sort cycles Rarity, Alphabetical and Missing First, missing accessories sit among the owned ones, and an accessory marked Enabled: Off shows as Disabled.

AP3 (cheat): Align stops you within a tick of entering the block, waits your dig a tick while it steers, and keeps the frozen view through a server teleport; Fast Align after a Spirit Leap into its block stops you 4-5 ticks after the landing tick (it used to give up on the fast plan and fall back to the regular align)

Swap Accounts: a new Sort button (Default, Name A-Z, Name Z-A, Recently Played, Most Playtime) and a Proxy filter (All, With Proxy, No Proxy) sit next to the search box and are remembered; the Playing as badge now grows to fit any name instead of cutting it, and so does the Swap Accounts button on the plain title screen.

Fiesta Flask Timer counts down by the second from the moment you drink and never pauses, snapping to the server's time whenever the tab list shows it; Mana Bar: Maniac Miner keeps draining for up to 50 seconds (was 35) and still stops at once on its end line.

summary: Auto Terminals: Burst Finish (cheat, off by default) sends a

sections.title: More
items: Auto Terminals: Burst Finish (cheat, off by default) sends a terminal's last clicks in one tick as soon as the server has answered the ones before, with Burst Size 1-21; Auto Terminals now waits until every slot of a terminal has loaded before its first click and works a terminal out again when no click has gone out for 2.5 seconds; Terminal Solver writes a board dump to the log when a terminal stays unsolved with nothing to click.
Multi Warp Mode: Burst or Tick Split (cheat; Tick Split spends only Blink Charge's bank, never flags)

Auto Clear no longer etherwarps again and again to a spot no trip lands on (it walks there or moves on); Autopilot's Blood First stops picking a door it cannot reach; an Auto Routes secret wait on a route Auto Secret drives goes on after 2 s when nothing in reach could still count; the Auto Water reward chest waits for the real unlock signal instead of clicking every 4 ticks for seconds (cheat)
Lever Aura and AP3 lever flicks never move your camera: the body turns to the lever for the server and your view stays put. (mod branch is based on ap3leveralways-1115: ship that line first)
Auto Routes: an item secret that lies near a chest you opened earlier is counted again, so a route no longer stalls waiting for it
Terminals no longer close the moment they open after a Fast Leap
Auto Routes: a route that comes back to an earlier tile fires the nodes in order; path arrivals still stack with their own tile's nodes
AP3 (cheat): crystals:<n> (or cr:<n>) waits for that many Maxor crystal phases to be complete (each 2/2 line), and the node editor row is After Crystal Phases
AP3: the Term Aura node no longer clicks the terminal a second time when the terminal window is slow to open, and your own left click waits while the body is turned to the terminal
Blink (cheat): with Charge on, a block you or Breaker Aura break shows and is walkable as soon as the server's break comes back, keeping the bank; Breaker Aura waits a tick for your right click.
/online now opens a screen with the same counts as the Discord /online; island sub-areas count under their island
Auto Routes: an etherwarp no longer waits an extra tick when Secret Aura hands the look back after clicking a lever or chest
Auto Clear: Door Only (cheat) goes to each wither door on the way to Blood, clicks it while a key is held, stops when Blood is open

Fixed the first Hypixel join after launch failing with "Status: 429": the mod no longer uses Mojang's login budget in the background, and Profile Viewer, Collection Tracker and the museum reader now use the relay's shared Hypixel key, so no API key and no SkyBlockPV login is needed.

Command Auto Correct now fixes swapped letters in short commands like /zb to /bz and /ha to /ah, plus extra, missing, wrong or doubled letters, all caps, a double slash, a missing space like /warpbase, and a mistyped /warp destination like /warp bsae to /warp base; a command that is already valid is never changed and a typo equally close to two commands is left alone
Auto Routes: clicking in a menu while a route holds sneak, or attacking while it turns for an etherwarp, no longer draws an anticheat flag
Click in Order (Terminal Solver and Auto Terminals) no longer gets stuck on the first pane after one click: the highlights move on to the next number and Auto Terminals stops clicking the wrong pane
Fixed a crash (the game closing with a stack overflow) when the Collection Tracker's saved settings were read for the first time
The Freeze State keys no longer print "Freeze State is turned off" while Freeze State is off; they just do nothing.
Split Timers: the lag figure now counts only server lag, never your own FPS drops or connection stalls

Blink Charge keeps its bank through teleports with no anticheat flags: a teleport sends its waiting answers and confirm at once (no more ~1 s teleport holds), warps in quick succession keep what the server covers, a second press joins a waiting shot, and Hypixel key releases fire within 50 ms; a mob teleported back near you while answers are held is held too, so hitting it during a delayed shot no longer flags; the lag threshold remembers your connection across Charge on and off
AP3: a walk or run node crossed during an align no longer takes over from the node you stand on when the align ends

Blood Rush Helper now shows the same boxes and role split as other mods that use the shared Blood Rush table, and reads party role claims in the shared chat format; rooms the table lacks keep our learned spots.
New Fiesta Flask Timer (Mining, off by default): a movable HUD line counting down your Fiesta Flask effect, with an expiry alert and an optional warning before it ends

Auto i4: new Terror Aim (default on) - with 2+ Terror Armor pieces at 10 Hydra Strike stacks your Machine Gun Shortbow's wider spread is aimed to cover more targets (the Terminator's usual aim already covers the row); Auto i4 also no longer shoots in the same tick as your own attack or hotbar key.

Dungeon features keep working when you leave and rejoin the same run mid-dungeon (map, collected secrets, splits, score, run timer, puzzles, boss phase, Blood Camp timer and stats, Blood Rush Helper, Leap Counter)

Dungeon sim: /wd opens the wardrobe, /stats, /eq and /equipment open Your Equipment and Stats where a click on a mask or helmet in your inventory swaps it with the one you wear, the wardrobe lists only armor sets, Terror and Thermodynamic armor are the real pieces in their real dyes, and /tpto i4 and /tpto sharpshooter take you to the section 4 device

Collection Tracker HUD now hides while nothing was gained recently (Only Recent on, or no collections picked); it returns the moment something is gained, and the HUD editor still shows it. Based on crashfix-colltrack-1116 (same file as colltrack-rate-1116, which says it ships after this).
Luck Tracker no longer floods the game log and slows the game down when you mine or when a big stack of items comes back into your inventory.
AP3: a run node walking into an align whose point is past a drop no longer aims off the platform at it, so the align starts at the edge and settles as close as is safe again.
Enchanted book slot text now abbreviates Drain, Pyroclasm, Woodsplitter, Gravity and Dragon Tracer by the name shown, not the old internal name (Drain was SY, now DR).

Collection Tracker: the per-hour rate now follows how fast you are gaining right now (a recent window, the Only Recent seconds or 5 minutes) instead of the whole session average and reads 0/h after an idle window; gains made with a menu open are no longer lost (moving items between a menu and your inventory is not a gain); compacted forms like Enchanted Gold count at their base value (160 each) without double counting sack lines. Ships after colltrack-hide-1116 (same files).
Fiesta Flask Timer: the Duration Minutes setting is gone; the flask always lasts Hypixel's fixed 60 minutes, and any time Hypixel shows for it still wins

summary: Sim: the Dungeon Breaker can no longer break smooth granite,

sections.title: More
items: Auto Routes: a bat the route gave up on is left alone instead of being revisited.
Sim: the Dungeon Breaker can no longer break smooth granite, pistons, dispensers, or blocks with a torch, button or fire on them
Dungeon sim: every sim setting (boss Spawn Withers and mode, loadout, filters, speed, co-op) is yours alone and no profile saves or changes it (built on profshare-1112)
Accessory Advisor: drag the panel anywhere (Reset Position in its tab), a mode button on the panel, and click an accessory's name to copy it

Enchants tab: new Hide Enchant Descriptions switch removes the description lines under each enchant name in item tooltips (enchanted books keep theirs unless Also On Enchanted Books is on); the enchant color settings now live in the same Enchants tab
Boss sim: starting or resetting a section or phase refills your Dungeon Breaker to full charges.
Glacite Tunnels commissions: the commission route, waypoints and progress now cover the Tunnels' commissions; right-click a commission in the menu to route to it
Commission Block Colors (off by default): the ores your open collector commission needs stand out and other ores are dimmed, in the Glacite Tunnels, Dwarven Mines and Crystal Hollows

Swap To Drill On Pigeon (cheat): picks the drill by the powder the finished commission gives (Mithril, Gemstone or Glacite) and its real powder bonus; new Rank Drills By setting (Powder Bonus or Compact Level)
Dungeon Sim: a left click on a terminal opens it just like a right click
Mod Chat Lobby mode no longer sends a command to find your lobby; it reads the server id Hypixel already shows on the scoreboard
Bug Report: /bugreport and /logreport now build the report zip too.
Glacite Mineshafts (all off by default): Mineshaft alert, entrance and ladder waypoints, corpse locator with loot value, and a cold / time-in-shaft HUD
Auto Routes: Master Mode One Try makes crypt, Mimic and Prince kill steps use one ability and move on in a Master Mode floor, and Skip Kills skips them.

Dungeon sim: new Sim Armor setting wears four pieces of Terror (Hydra Strike always at 10 stacks, two extra arrows plus damage and arrow speed bonuses) or Thermodynamic (Attack Speed at the raised cap), saved with the loadout
Treasure Chest Alert now only sounds and shows in the Crystal Hollows.

Auto Routes: a saved path warp that can no longer go from its spot (a block now in its line, or its landing block gone for a second) is planned again from where you stand and flown, instead of waiting for a left click; stepping back onto a warp spot no longer stalls 2 s after landing
Blink Charge no longer draws an anticheat flag when a lag release of its held answers lands in the same tick as Zero Ping Etherwarp Aimed Warps.

Servers can no longer tell the mod is installed from anything the client sends: no mod text can be read back through signs, anvils or key names, and the mod no longer shows up in the server's resource pack check.
Auto Routes: a bat the route gave up on is left alone instead of being revisited, and a crypt left after one try or skipped in Master Mode is not revisited either.
AP3 routes past an S2 lever now walk the same whether the lever is already flipped or not

Carnival: the autos work out their own aim (Lead Adjust removed) and turn and react more like a person, Zombie Shootout fires one dart per zombie and leads from the zombie's real position, Catch a Fish follows fish that swim in circles, aims where the cast comes to rest after its glide on the water, no longer casts into a blocked path and reels back a bobber that rests on the bank, Auto Accept Game answers the new prompt, Auto Shovel Swap hears the shovel switch and taps again when a tap is lost, Auto Fruit Digging walks onto every pick and never digs in the wrong mode, and the game start teleport no longer reads as a server correction, and a cast still learns the right range when the server lags
Auto Routes: a route that returns to a block it used earlier no longer skips the nodes in between
Dungeon sim: new /wardrobe and /equipment menus to swap between None, Terror and Thermodynamic armor and see the stats of what is worn (stacked on Sim Armor)

summary: Sim F7: after Goldor dies Necron pulls everyone down into hi

sections.title: More
items: Sim F7: after Goldor dies Necron pulls everyone down into his arena and holds them over his platform until "Goodbye."; P5 dragons now carry Hypixel's 1,000,000,000 health, so the Wither Dragons health readout drops as you hit them, and every arrow of a Terminator volley counts; dragons rise out of their spawn point and then circle their own area instead of flying at random. Wither Dragons' health label now shows the health the server sent.
Auto Melody no longer skips a whole bounce when a row's pane arrives right on its target after a lookahead click (Lookahead Clicks is a 1-in-5 guess per row; 0 loses nothing)
Boss sim: the Hyperion no longer teleports you in the boss fight (its blast still hits), and blocking an Ender pearl in the boss no longer shows a title
AP3: your own right click, dig or hotbar swap during a route no longer throws the held walk off or stops AP3 (held one tick and sent)
Sim Terminator: spam left-clicking now shoots every 4 ticks (5.00 shots/s at 100 Attack Speed, like Hypixel); holding right click stays 4.00/s

Storm Bow: releases a held Last Breath at a set charge tick (default 34.25), with optional Terminator swap and walk; Auto M5: walks to your saved mid, Ragnarock buff, aims at and kills the real Livid (cheat, both off by default)

Treasure Chest Highlight: a chest that appears beside a block you just dug is now always boxed, even when the chat line is missing, you have moved away, or another player's chest appeared near you first
Internal test fixes for Blink and Auto Path Pilot test cases (no change for players)
Fewer anticheat flags while you move: Auto Close Chest waits until you stand still before it closes the chest (chat and commands are never delayed)

Profiles: AP3 routes, Auto Routes, waypoints, Breaker Aura and Inventory Sorter layouts and imported fonts and sounds are now shared by every profile on the instance, so loading another profile never loses a route; each profile still keeps which route file it uses
Inventory Sorter (cheat): items a layout needs that storage did not supply are taken from your sacks with /gfs, only the shortfall (Fetch Missing From Sacks, on by default)
AP3: routes that drop to a lower floor or walk into an align now land on the floor with 45 Degree Strafe on (the EE3 route no longer falls into the lava)
Secret Waypoints: Community Routes draws premade per-room routes (path line, etherwarp, mine and click boxes) from a local route folder or a cached public download; nothing is shipped in the jar
Terminal Solver: Starts With now highlights items that glint on their own (Enchanted Book, Enchanted Golden Apple, End Crystal), so an E board no longer looks solved with nothing marked.

Carnival: Auto Dialogue works anywhere and answers Carnival NPCs through a Carnival Games row, Carnival is its own section in Misc, the autos stop only on Escape or the Emergency Cancel Key, Fruit Digging draws one box per tile, Auto Shovel Swap no longer grabs your AOTV, Auto Accept Game fix, and Zombie Shootout and Catch a Fish now lead their targets (Lead Adjust), read the fish bar and no longer need Hook Wait
Blood Rush Helper: the built-in spawn boxes now cover 80 of the 124 mob rooms (8 more rooms, 671 spots), and learned spots outside a room are ignored
AP3: /ap3 redo right after a delete or clear puts it back, like /ar redo
Accessory Bag advisor: suggests the next accessory to get (best overall, upgrade only, buy new, cheapest, cheapest per Magical Power)
Wither Aimbot (cheat, off by default): in the Wither Boss Triggerbot tab, turns smoothly onto the boss wither you pick per boss, with Auto Hit and Hold Left Click options

summary: Proxy Client: servers on localhost, your LAN or a private ad

sections.title: More
items: Proxy Client: servers on localhost, your LAN or a private address now connect directly instead of through the SOCKS proxy, so a local test server can be joined with the proxy on.
Friends List: online friends are listed first, even while a sync is running
Sim: /simboss <phase> typed inside a running F7 boss fight resets the fight and arena but no longer moves you
The dungeon sim skips mob spots a player cannot walk to (walled in behind a lever or outside the room), so Auto Clear no longer stalls on 'no etherwarp path' in rooms like Redstone Crypt.
Sim F7: terminal stands no longer burn, the Arrows device lights only behind solved arrows, clicking a terminal never takes your held item, and Necron's health drops only when you hit him
Breaker Aura: Edit Mode now turns itself off when you change worlds (leaving the dungeon) and after a restart, so picked blocks no longer stay drawn with the aura off.

Party Commands: !killer560 / !k560 / !killer now reply with the Discord invite code instead of a link Hypixel censored to ****, and clicking the already-selected Chat Tab no longer sends a second /chat that drew "You're already in this channel!"
none (test fixes; profiles no longer carry sim mob looks / Carnival history records)
Online Count: /online now counts you in a singleplayer world (the sim) or on another server too
Dungeon Breaker: removed the Zero Ping option (it never acted); Don't break secrets stays
Swap To Drill On Pigeon no longer prints the Swapped to line in chat.
AP3: a server teleport that sets your look ends the look glide; Blink Charge teleport hold is capped just under the answer delay (no TimerLimit)
Dungeon sim: typing /pc, /ac, /msg and the other chat commands no longer shows red or an unknown-command error, and Mask Swapper no longer sends /stats in the sim
Scrollable Tooltips: the mouse wheel now scrolls a tall tooltip on every screen (inventory, creative, menus, Profile Viewer), and the server resending a slot no longer snaps it back to the top

What's New has a new look: date chips across the top and one box with the whole update; the main menu is split into three sections, and on small windows the logo shrinks instead of covering the buttons
Leap Order: a class you pick for yourself now wins over the tab list

Fast Leap (cheat): Crystal Auto now leaps the moment you pick up an Energy Crystal (your own pickup only, in Phase 1), and a double click right after a leap no longer prints "Failed to leap! On cooldown".

AP3 Edge Jump jumps on the grounded tick nearer the edge.
